description: Changes an agent's configuration or enabled state.

connectorTools.description: Whether the agent also gets the read-only tools of the organization's connectors.

coreSkills.description: Names of the platform skills the agent loads, from `GET /v1/agent-options`; an unknown name is refused on write.

customSkills.description: Ids of the organization's own skills the agent loads; disabled or deleted ones are ignored.

enabled.description: Whether members can chat with the agent.

instructions.description: Markdown instructions written by the organization; untrusted input placed after the platform's own instructions.

knowledgeScope.description: What the agent may search in the knowledge base.

model.description: Model role the agent runs on, from the platform's allowlist.

tools.description: Ids of the tools the agent may call, from `GET /v1/agent-options`; an id the runtime does not offer is refused on write (one that disappears later is ignored at run time).
